mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.merchant_id, s.store_id, s.category_id, c.category_name, s.service_name, s.description, s.price, s.duration_minutes, s.fulfillment_type, s.status FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.id = #{serviceId}

SELECT s.id, s.merchant_id, s.store_id, s.category_id, c.category_name, s.service_name, s.description, s.price, s.duration_minutes, s.fulfillment_type, s.status FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_item s WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
